title: Chile + Peru — Summer 2027
subtitle: Santiago · Valle Nevado ski days · Sacred Valley · Machu Picchu · Cusco · Lima
summary:
Family trip (Niko + **Henri** 17 + **Renée** 15) combining **3–4 ski days at Valle Nevado** (Chile) with the Peru spine: **Lima → Sacred Valley → Machu Picchu → Cusco**. July is the only month where both countries are simultaneously at their seasonal best — Chilean winter ski peak AND Peruvian dry-season hiking peak.

The linchpin: **LATAM flies Santiago → Cusco non-stop** (daily, ~2h30–3h30), so the two halves stitch together without backtracking through Lima. Bonus: 3–4 days above 3,000 m at Valle Nevado pre-acclimatises everyone for Cusco (3,400 m).

**Stage: planned** — dates set (Sat Jul 17 → Mon Aug 2), nothing booked yet. Booking windows: international flights by Jan 2027, Valle Nevado by Mar 2027, Machu Picchu permits Jan–Feb 2027.

practical.notes:
⚠️ **Fiestas Patrias (Jul 28–29)** falls inside this window — Peruvian Independence Day: festive parades in Cusco/Lima, but trains, flights and hotels around those dates fill up and prices peak. Book PeruRail + internal flights before Jan 2027.

**Gear**: rent everything at Valle Nevado/Farellones (~$30–50/day pp) — no board bags on the Peru internal flights. **Altitude**: VN base 3,000 m / summit 3,670 m pre-acclimatises for Cusco (3,400 m); Sacred Valley (2,800 m) first, Cusco after. Budget delta over the Peru-only trip: ~+€4.5–7k → ~€15–19k family.

days.notes: ~17h with 1–2 stops (Iberia via Madrid, Air France via Paris, KLM via Amsterdam, Delta, Turkish). July = peak — book by Jan 2027, expect ~$1,400–1,800 pp RT.

days.title: Transfer to Valle Nevado + warm-up
days.notes: **G-21 road: up-window 08:00–13:00.** Shared shuttle SCL→VN (~$35–40 pp, 90 min). Afternoon: rental fitting + one gentle warm-up run — first exposure at 3,000 m, take it easy.

blocks.title: Shuttle Santiago → Valle Nevado
blocks.description: 90 min. Leave before 13:00 — the G-21 access road only allows uphill traffic in the morning window.

blocks.title: Stay: self-catered studio, ski-in/out
blocks.description: ~$330–420/nt (or Farellones for budget). 4-day ski pass: weekday ~$33/day, weekend ~$55.

blocks.title: Valle Nevado full day
blocks.description: Renée: groomed blues/reds front side (25% intermediate terrain). Henri: advanced bowls. Niko: wide groomers. Hydrate, layers, sunscreen — altitude sun is brutal.

blocks.title: Valle Nevado + La Parva
blocks.description: One pass covers the interconnected terrain — La Parva adds intermediate cruising + big views. Weather-chase: pick the side with best visibility.

days.title: Ski day 3 (morning) → Santiago
days.notes: **G-21 down-window 15:00–20:00.** Morning ski, lunch at the resort, transfer down ~15:00. Night near SCL airport for the morning flight.

days.title: SCL → CUZ → Sacred Valley
days.notes: The linchpin flight: LATAM direct, daily in season, ~2h30–3h30 — book a morning departure. Then the **critical acclimatisation move**: transfer straight to the Sacred Valley (~1.5h, 2,800 m) instead of sleeping in Cusco (3,400 m).

blocks.title: LATAM SCL → CUZ (direct)
blocks.description: ~2h30–3h30. The stitch that makes this trip work.

days.title: Machu Picchu

days.title: Cusco city + 🎉 Fiestas Patrias
